ev_0006.summary: Figure (569x367) is a semicircle of center V (264.2,300.4), radius ~235.8 px, upper half only (visible 180-360 deg), with endpoints on a horizontal diameter at y~301 spanning x=23 to x=506 (right end snapped to A at 500.5, since the 5.5 px overshoot is detector noise; left overhang kept). Labels bound by the supervisor and bind_point_labels agree: A (500.5,300.9), B (264,64.6), C (264,237.5), V (264.2,300.7). B is the arc apex, directly above V, and the vertical segment BV (x=264) is solid. Segment AC is solid at 15 deg above horizontal from A to C, and C lies on BV (x=264) so CV is the lower part of BV. A lies at distance ~236.2 px from V, matching the radius within ~0.4 px, so A is the right arc endpoint. No right-angle mark was verified (detect_right_angle_marker returned 0 marks), so no right_angle object is submitted.
